cause: Training/serving skew on f4 due to a missing transformation in the serving path. The training pipeline applies a log1p transform to f4 (f4_train = log(1 + raw)), while the online serving path emits the raw, untransformed value. Verified on the platform via Trino: across all 200 entities present in both feature groups, f1/f2/f3/f5 match exactly (mean abs diff 0.0), whereas f4 differs systematically and satisfies serve_f4 = exp(train_f4) - 1 = expm1(train_f4) with max abs error 2.4e-5 (CSV rounding). I.e. serving serves the pre-log raw value while training serves log1p(raw).
